body: Ito yung rare paperwork na mataas ang value-to-effort: targeted na ang mailing, recurring ang possible benefit, at may tunay na cost ang delay. Hindi kailangang i-optimize nang todo—kung official green packet ang dumating, submit early rather than aiming for January 4. The example ¥22,480 retroactive amount is not universal, pero sapat siyang reminder na ang ‘mamaya na’ sa small government form can quietly become a five-digit loss.

claims.text: Submitting the targeted official claim early has high value relative to effort because delay can forfeit retroactive months while the benefit can recur monthly.
claims.basis: Value inference from the article's official deadline mechanics and benefit formula.
